Descriptions.ShortDescription: Live focuser control with ROI HFR history, a 3x3 sensor inspector and star, deep-sky and solar-system target selection
Descriptions.LongDescription: Adjust the focuser with configurable In / Out steps while watching live camera images in NINA's Image panel. Select and edit an ROI, monitor live HFR in the native HFR History panel, and compare sensor-center, edge and corner star shapes with Inspector 3x3. Go to target provides bright-star altitude/magnitude filters, deep-sky catalogue search and Moon/planet selection. Slew directly or use NINA plate solving with Slew + Center for stellar and deep-sky targets. Cameras without live-view support use successive exposures. This plugin does not run autofocus.
